heading: Optional automatic host key trust and OTP-friendly agent sessions
summary: Each bookmark can let agents trust new or changed host keys without asking, with a clear warning. Agents also wait properly while you enter a one-time password.
changes: Choose off, new keys only, or new and changed keys for each bookmark. Turning it on shows a warning, and every automatic trust is recorded.
An old key in ~/.ssh/known_hosts or /etc/ssh no longer stops a connection before PromeFTP can ask.
A prompt extends the authentication limit to 3 minutes, and agents can wait for the session with promeftp session wait.
Status responses and the agent skill explain how to keep a session open and what to do after it ends.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
